name: Worms
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
      A variant of the "Worms" pattern with edge-detector feedback. Chemicals c and d are used only for visualization.
    </description>
    <rule name="Worms" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.02
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.025
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.064
      </param>
      <param name="aConst">
        0.6
      </param>
      <param name="bConst">
        -1.26
      </param>
      <param name="dps">
        0.017
      </param>
      <param name="aScale">
        10
      </param>
      <param name="bScale">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="acS">
        0.16
      </param>
      <param name="bcS">
        0.24
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
        float4 uax = (float4)(
(-(a_nw.w + a_sw.w) + (a_n.y   + a_s.y) - 2.0 * a_w.w + 2.0 * a.y  ),
(-(a_n.x  + a_s.x)  + (a_n.z   + a_s.z) - 2.0 * a.x   + 2.0 * a.z  ),
(-(a_n.y  + a_s.y)  + (a_n.w   + a_s.w) - 2.0 * a.y   + 2.0 * a.w  ),
(-(a_n.z  + a_s.z)  + (a_ne.x + a_se.x) - 2.0 * a.z   + 2.0 * a_e.x));

float4 uay = (float4)(
((a_nw.w + a_n.y ) - (a_sw.w +  a_s.y) - 2.0 * a_s.x + 2.0 * a_n.x),
((a_n.x  + a_n.z ) - (a_s.x  +  a_s.z) - 2.0 * a_s.y + 2.0 * a_n.y),
((a_n.y  + a_n.w ) - (a_s.y  +  a_s.w) - 2.0 * a_s.z + 2.0 * a_n.z),
((a_n.z  + a_ne.x) - (a_s.z  + a_se.x) - 2.0 * a_s.w + 2.0 * a_n.w));

float4 ubx = (float4)(
(-(b_nw.w + b_sw.w) + (b_n.y   + b_s.y) - 2.0 * b_w.w + 2.0 * b.y  ),
(-(b_n.x  + b_s.x)  + (b_n.z   + b_s.z) - 2.0 * b.x   + 2.0 * b.z  ),
(-(b_n.y  + b_s.y)  + (b_n.w   + b_s.w) - 2.0 * b.y   + 2.0 * b.w  ),
(-(b_n.z  + b_s.z)  + (b_ne.x + b_se.x) - 2.0 * b.z   + 2.0 * b_e.x));

float4 uby = (float4)(
((b_nw.w + b_n.y ) - (b_sw.w +  b_s.y) - 2.0 * b_s.x + 2.0 * b_n.x),
((b_n.x  + b_n.z ) - (b_s.x  +  b_s.z) - 2.0 * b_s.y + 2.0 * b_n.y),
((b_n.y  + b_n.w ) - (b_s.y  +  b_s.w) - 2.0 * b_s.z + 2.0 * b_n.z),
((b_n.z  + b_ne.x) - (b_s.z  + b_se.x) - 2.0 * b_s.w + 2.0 * b_n.w));

float4 mm_b = (float4)(
(b_nw.w + b_n.x + b_n.y  + b_w.w + b.y   + b_sw.w + b_s.x + b_s.y ),
(b_n.x  + b_n.y + b_n.z  + b.x   + b.z   + b_s.x  + b_s.y + b_s.z ),
(b_n.y  + b_n.z + b_n.w  + b.y   + b.w   + b_s.y  + b_s.z + b_s.w ),
(b_n.z  + b_n.w + b_ne.x + b.z   + b_e.x + b_s.z  + b_s.w + b_se.x));

float4 mm_c = (float4)(
(c_nw.w + c_n.x + c_n.y  + c_w.w + c.y   + c_sw.w + c_s.x + c_s.y ),
(c_n.x  + c_n.y + c_n.z  + c.x   + c.z   + c_s.x  + c_s.y + c_s.z ),
(c_n.y  + c_n.z + c_n.w  + c.y   + c.w   + c_s.y  + c_s.z + c_s.w ),
(c_n.z  + c_n.w + c_ne.x + c.z   + c_e.x + c_s.z  + c_s.w + c_se.x));

float4 dp = pow(pow(uax * ubx - uay * uby, 2) + pow(uay * ubx + uax * uby, 2), 0.5);

c = pow((mm_b + b + 3)/10, 5)*20;
d = (mm_c + c) * 0.1;
delta_a = (D_a * (a * a - b * b)) + aScale * laplacian_b + aConst * b - acS * sign(a) * a * a;
delta_b = dps * dp + D_b * a * b - bScale * laplacian_a + bConst * a - bcS * sign(b) * b * b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-0.9" high="-9.05">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>

      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="0.7" high="5.9">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
